title: Crftd and the ROOTS days at school fests · AquaTerra
description: Crftd, AquaTerra's student streetwear label, was called ROOTS. The name ran through planting workshops from 2021 and the 2025 tee days at Kolkata school fests.
lede: Crftd is AquaTerra's student streetwear label, and it was called ROOTS before. The name first appeared on planting and painting workshops in 2021 and 2022. In July and August 2025 it came to school fests across Kolkata as Roots tee days, with students wearing the tees at each one. Across this topic there are {count} days and workshops under the name, with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts.

sections.heading: where the name started
body: The name was on planting and painting workshops before it was on any tees. Roots in Mud was a planting workshop at Ek Tara in August 2021, where students got their hands muddy planting saplings. Roots Rise, a saplings painting drive at Mallickpur in April 2022, had students painting saplings, and Roots and Rise, a bottle planting workshop at Jyotirmai in July 2022, planted trees.
Those early days were planting and painting with children, the same family of workshops as much of our school work, and they are where the word ROOTS first meant something to us.

sections.heading: the tee days of 2025
body: In July and August 2025 the Roots name went to school fests. Morpheus Day 1 and 2 ran at South City International School on 3 and 4 July, Concord Day 1 and 2 at Calcutta Boys School on 7 and 8 July, Confluence Day 1 and 2 at Calcutta International School on 25 and 26 July, and Novus at The Newtown School on 1 August.

Each day's own notes give a walk-in figure. Morpheus Day 2 notes 350 walk-ins, the highest of the tee days, and Novus at The Newtown School notes 300. The summaries describe students wearing Roots tees with pride at each fest.

sections.heading: what a tee day looked like
body: On the tee days, students wore Roots tees at the school fests, and the fest was where the walk-ins came in. The Concord and Confluence summaries say the tees brought passion, pride and spirit to each school's fest, and the Morpheus summaries say students rocked the tees at South City.
Morpheus, Concord and Confluence each ran over two days, so the same fest was a plan for two days rather than one.

sections.heading: from roots to crftd
body: Crftd is AquaTerra's student streetwear label, and it was called ROOTS before. The tees students wore at the 2025 fests carried that name. AquaTerra is self-funded and takes no donations, and it pays for its welfare work with its own student-run events and with Crftd, its student streetwear label.
If you want to see the label itself, the [Crftd page](/crftd) is where it lives on the site.

sections.heading: how to help
body: Students can [join AquaTerra](/join) and volunteer on the next fest day, or help with the label. The ROOTS planting workshops show the other side of the work: students who came to plant and paint saplings with children.
For more of the nights that pay for the work, see [every night that paid for the work](/impact/the-nights-that-fund-the-work) and [how we fund the work](/impact/how-we-fund-the-work).

learnings: A name can outlive its first use: Roots began on planting workshops in 2021 and came back on tees at school fests in 2025.
Fest days bring walk-ins: each 2025 tee day noted a walk-in figure of its own, and the figures ran into the hundreds.
Run a two-day fest as one plan: Morpheus, Concord and Confluence each ran over two days at the same school.
Planting and painting with children were the earliest format under the name, before the tees.

faqs.a: Crftd is AquaTerra's student streetwear label. It was called ROOTS before, and its tees were worn at school fests across Kolkata in July and August 2025. It is one of the student-run ways AquaTerra pays for its welfare work.

faqs.q: What were the Roots tee days?
faqs.a: The Roots tee days were fest days in July and August 2025 at South City International School, Calcutta Boys School, Calcutta International School and The Newtown School. Students wore Roots tees at each one, and walk-in figures were noted for each day.

faqs.q: Was ROOTS the old name of Crftd?
faqs.a: Yes. Crftd, AquaTerra's student streetwear label, was called ROOTS before. The ROOTS name was already on planting and painting workshops in 2021 and 2022 before the tees appeared at school fests in 2025.

faqs.q: Does AquaTerra fund its welfare work through clothing?
faqs.a: AquaTerra is self-funded and takes no donations. It pays for its welfare work with its own student-run events and with Crftd, its student streetwear label.

faqs.q: How can I get involved with Crftd or the Roots days?
faqs.a: Join AquaTerra as a student and volunteer on the next fest day. The Crftd page on this site explains the label, and fest days are written up on the site too.
